entries.name: /undo — remove the last local exchange
entries.purpose: Remove the last local user/assistant exchange from the active workstream's history (local edit only).
entries.promise: Typing /undo (when idle) pops the trailing assistant + user messages from ws.history, re-renders, and reports how many were removed; it refuses while a turn is running and no-ops on empty history.
entries.notes: Live-proven @ seed :8965 / CDP :9365 (evidence .uiatlas/commands-live.json + commands-boundary.json). /undo → 'Nothing to undo.' — honest empty-history no-op (refuses to fabricate a removal).

entries.name: /usage — show real spend from the station ledger
entries.purpose: Tell the Commander what the station has actually SPENT, from the same ledger the budget caps enforce against.
entries.promise: Typing /usage prints today's spend (against the daily cap when one is set), all-time spend with run count and token total, and this agent's share — every figure read from the sidecar spend ledger, so it includes headless runs (routines, away shifts, night shift, messaging) the browser never observed. Sub-cent spend renders as </usr/bin/bash.01, never /usr/bin/bash.00. An unreadable ledger refuses rather than reporting zero.
